Population increased in North Somerset

The estimated population of North Somerset in 2024 was 224,578 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that North Somerset's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North Somerset increased by 3.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, North Somerset was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North Somerset

The average (median) age fell to 45.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North Somerset has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North Somerset is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North Somerset's population of 224,578 usual residents was made up of:

  • 39,227 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 131,401 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.5%)
  • 53,950 people aged 65 years and over, (24%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North Somerset has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North Somerset, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North Somerset
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North Somerset, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 661 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 1,871 births and 2,532 deaths in North Somerset.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,355 (1.1%). There were 11,620 people entering the area and 9,265 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North Somerset's population of 950 (0.4%) as a result of 1,699 people entering the area and 749 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North Somerset was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North Somerset in mid-2023 is 221,927.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 273 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 508 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 781 people.
